items:
Welcome to Beach Bliss, your perfect 30A getaway! This spacious 4-bedroom, 3-bath home comfortably sleeps up to 12 guests and combines relaxation with convenience. Spend your days lounging by the private pool, soaking in the covered hot tub, or gathering in the backyard oasis complete with outdoor seating and a privacy fence. When it's time to hit the beach, hop on the included golf cart and be there in minutes, or take the bikes through the brand-new pedestrian underpass for quick and easy access. Just steps from the front door, you'll find 30Avenue—a lively outdoor lifestyle center offering restaurants, bars, boutique shops, live music, and games. Whether you're looking for laid-back poolside afternoons, evenings filled with dining and entertainment, or fun-filled beach days, Beach Bliss puts it all at your fingertips. Monthly discounts are available for longer stays from November to February!

Features to love:
- Private hot tub with shade covering – stay cool and relaxed while enjoying a little extra privacy.
- Heated private pool with loungers, hammock chairs, and an umbrella – your backyard escape for sunbathing, reading, or unwinding.
- Outdoor dining + gas grill – keep the fun outside with family barbecues and poolside meals.
- Bright, open floor plan inside – kitchen, living, and dining flow together so everyone stays connected.
- 2nd-floor balcony – the perfect spot for morning coffee, a good book, or an evening nightcap.
- 6-seater golf cart + 4 complimentary bikes – cruise to the beach or explore 30A in style.
- Easy beach access – just 5 minutes by golf cart to Inlet Beach Regional, 30A's largest access point with parking, showers, lifeguards, and restrooms. Prefer to walk? Take the new - pedestrian underpass with colorful murals and reach the sand in about 8 minutes.
- Family-friendly amenities – traveling with little ones is stress-free with a Pack 'n Play and highchair included.
- Walkable neighborhood dining – stroll to local favorites like Amici for Italian or Cuvee for small plates. Craving something sweet? Donut Hole Café is a must (trust us, you'll thank us later). 🍩
- Rosemary Beach nearby – hop across the new underpass to discover boutique shopping, brunch spots, and dining gems like La Playa (for acai bowls), Cowgirl Kitchen (casual eats), or Gallion's (perfect date night).
-Guests of Kalos now receive 20% off all Sculpt Studio fitness classes at The Big Chill! Ask us for details.

Included in your stay:
- Beach-ready gear – wagon, cooler, chairs, towels, and sand toys provided so you can pack light.
- Public Goods essentials – eco-friendly shampoo, conditioner, body wash, and soap in every bathroom.
- Starter kit – paper towels, toilet paper, dish soap, and laundry detergent to get you going.
- Morning pick-me-up – complimentary coffee from The Well, with both a standard drip and Keurig machine.

Where you'll sleep:
- Primary Bedroom (First Floor) – Queen bed with en suite bathroom.
- Primary Suite (Second Floor, bonus!) – King bed with en suite bathroom and balcony access.
- Guest Bedroom 2 – Queen bed.
- Guest Bedroom 3 – Double-over-double bunk with full trundle plus an additional twin-over-twin bunk.
- Looking for a long-term stay? We offer discounted monthly rates and would love to host your extended getaway. We're so glad you found us—please reach out anytime with questions!

Other things to note:
- Parking: 2 spaces officially, extra parking by mailboxes. No on street parking permitted.
- The pool can be heated for $50/day. Please inquire with us when booking and we can set up for you!
- The word is out! 30A is one of Florida's best vacation spots. Unfortunately, more visitors means less parking options. Additional parking spaces are the responsibility of the renter. We recommend looking into nearby storage facilities who offer long term parking options in their lots.
- Minimum age to rent the home is 25.
- Apologies, no furry friends are allowed at the home. We appreciate your understanding on this.
- Vacation disruptions can be a bummer. While it doesn't happen often, you may experience issues with Wi-Fi or construction on 30A. We are not responsible for any disruptions to the Wi-Fi service or any construction that may affect your experience. Please note that such occurrences are beyond our control, and we appreciate your understanding and patience in these matters.

Emerald Coast Mirror Maze and SkyWheel are also worth visiting. Discover the area's water adventures with kayaking, snorkeling, and parasailing nearby, or enjoy the great outdoors with hiking/biking trails.
